verses.english: “Mendicants, these five qualities make a trainee self-assured.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, paññavā hoti.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant is faithful, ethical, learned, energetic, and wise.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, assaddhassa sārajjaṁ hoti, saddhassa taṁ sārajjaṁ na hoti.
verses.english: A person of faith doesn’t have the insecurities of someone who lacks faith.
So this quality makes a trainee self-assured.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, dussīlassa sārajjaṁ hoti, sīlavato taṁ sārajjaṁ na hoti.
verses.english: An ethical person doesn’t have the insecurities of someone who is unethical.
So this quality makes a trainee self-assured.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, appassutassa sārajjaṁ hoti, bahussutassa taṁ sārajjaṁ na hoti.
verses.english: A learned person doesn’t have the insecurities of a person of little learning.
So this quality makes a trainee self-assured.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, kusītassa sārajjaṁ hoti, āraddhavīriyassa taṁ sārajjaṁ na hoti.
verses.english: An energetic person doesn’t have the insecurities of a lazy person.
So this quality makes a trainee self-assured.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, duppaññassa sārajjaṁ hoti, paññavato taṁ sārajjaṁ na hoti.
verses.english: A wise person doesn’t have the insecurities of someone who is witless.
So this quality makes a trainee self-assured.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca sekhavesārajjakaraṇā dhammā”ti.
verses.english: These are the five qualities that make a trainee self-assured.”
